tooltip.ftdungeonmobs.gate.size: 3 blocks wide x 4 high; place at bottom center on three sturdy blocks
tooltip.ftdungeonmobs.gate.entry: Nearest brazier within 6 blocks: unlit closes, tiers 1-5 open and tint portal; first entry locks tier and starts a 5-minute admission window
tooltip.ftdungeonmobs.gate.return: Inside the dungeon, open then walk through or right-click the frame to return to your own origin
tooltip.ftdungeonmobs.gate.control: Right-click brazier or entry wall torch: unlit→1→2→3→4→5→unlit; return gate stays open; no pressure plate
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.closed: The iron gate is not fully open. Light the nearest entry brazier, then wait about 2 seconds.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.opening: The iron gate is sinking open... Walk through when it finishes to travel.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.closing: The iron gate is rising closed... It reopens if a living entity enters the passage.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.obstructed: A living entity is in the passage. Clear the doorway before closing.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.incomplete: Incomplete gate structure; place the gate again.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.entry_outside: Place entrance gates outside the dungeon; use a return gate to leave.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.return_inside: Return gates only work inside the dungeon dimension.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.missing_dimen: Dungeon dimension unavailable; fully restart the server/world after installing this version.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.missing_brazi: Place and light the nearest Bloodthorn Brazier within 6 blocks; right-click cycles tiers, unlit closes the entry.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.locked_window: A player has entered. This round's braziers and tier are locked; teammates have %s seconds left to enter.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.locked: This round's braziers are locked. Admission has ended; all participants must leave the dungeon to unlock them.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.admission_clo: The 5-minute admission window has ended. Entry is closed; the return gate still works for players inside.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.admission_rem: Round tier locked. Teammates have %s seconds to enter; later entrants do not extend the window.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.exit_open: The return gate stays open independently of the entry window. Walk through once fully open to leave.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.occupied: Players are inside the shared dungeon. Use the active entrance or wait until everyone leaves before rebinding.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.arrival_block: The arrival hall or return gate is obstructed. Existing builds will not be overwritten.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.unsafe: No safe supported landing spot without collision, fluids or hazards; teleport cancelled.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.cancelled: Dimension travel was cancelled by the server or another mod; your return record was preserved.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.cannot_travel: Dismount and leave sleep before travelling; living players only, no vehicles or passengers.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.cooldown: Dungeon gate cooling down; please wait (2 seconds).
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.entered: Dungeon entered · Round tier locked at %s / 5 · %s
message.ftdungeonmobs.gate.returned_fall: Original return point missing or unsafe; returned near overworld spawn.
tooltip.ftdungeonmobs.bloodthorn_brazier: Server controls radius (default 32 blocks); needs one block and a sturdy base
Tier flames: azure → emerald → gold → violet → crimson
message.ftdungeonmobs.bloodthorn_tier: Bloodthorn Brazier · Difficulty %s / 5 · %s | Radius %s | Updated %s mobs
tooltip.ftdungeonmobs.arena_torch.cycle: Right-click: unlit→1→2→3→4→5→unlit. Nearby gate opening and portal tint follow the tier; first entry locks this round.
tooltip.ftdungeonmobs.arena_torch.radius: Server controls radius (default 32 blocks); needs two blocks of height
tooltip.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.altar: 9x9 stepped pool; 16 offering points, then empty-hand confirm: redstone/event trigger
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.busy: The ritual is active or cooling down; no offerings accepted.
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.charge: Offering charge %s / %s. Empty-hand right-click when full.
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.ready: Ready. Empty-hand right-click to confirm the ritual.
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.invalid: Offer bones/flesh/nuggets (1), gold ingots (2), emeralds (4), diamonds or mob heads (8).
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.missing: Fill all 44 pool cells with source blood; flowing blood does not count.
The pool needs solid full-top supports beneath every blood cell.
Complete the 24 boundary cells of the stepped 9x9 octagonal pool.
Place bloodstone bricks at the center, then a skull shrine facing the altar above.
Part of the pool is out of bounds or unloaded.
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.cancell: A server extension cancelled activation; charge was kept.
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.activat: Ritual activated: redstone 15 for 10 seconds, then 30 seconds cooldown.
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.build_b: Build area is out of bounds or unloaded; nothing was placed.
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.build_o: An existing block/fluid at %s blocks construction; nothing was placed.
message.ftdungeonmobs.blood_pool.built: Built %s pool blocks. This provides a ritual trigger, not automatic monster waves.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.built: New rooms connected: head south from the lobby for room 31, or east along the path for the 30_1 amethyst annex. Containers remain empty; waves and rewards are not enabled.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.ready: Rooms already built; no reconstruction. Room 31 origin: (-33,65,32); room 30_1 origin: (43,65,32).
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.pending: Rooms are not built yet. Successful entry runs a safe check; administrators may also use /ftdungeon rooms build.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.dimension: FT dungeon dimension unavailable. Rooms can only be built in ftdungeonmobs:dungeon.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.template: Room template or block dependency unavailable (%s); nothing changed. Room 31 requires Lootr. Check the server log; the original lobby and return route remain available.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.occupied: A block or fluid at %s obstructs the new rooms. No construction or clearing occurred; the original lobby and return route remain available.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.entity: Entities near %s obstruct construction. Leave the construction area and try again.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.bounds: Room area at %s is out of bounds; nothing changed.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.failed: Room construction failed; this attempt's block changes were rolled back. Check the server log. The original lobby and return route remain available.
message.ftdungeonmobs.rooms.rollback_fai: Room construction and rollback both failed. Stop retrying; an administrator must inspect the log and restore a backup.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.built: [%s] %s connected; north entrance: %s. Follow the lobby's east branch, illuminated trunk and room branch.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.ready: [%s] %s already built; player changes preserved. Origin: %s.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.changed: [%s] %s template or layout changed. Existing room at %s will not be overwritten; administrator migration required.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.template: [%s] %s failed delivery/safety checks: %s. Nothing placed for this room; other rooms are independent.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.bounds: [%s] %s is out of bounds at %s; nothing placed.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.occupied: [%s] %s reserved volume is occupied at %s. No clearing or overwriting.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.path: [%s] %s approach or headroom is occupied at %s. No overwriting; administrator inspection required.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.entity: [%s] %s has an entity obstructing construction or access at %s; nothing placed.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.failed: [%s] %s placement failed and block changes were restored: %s. Check the server log.
message.ftdungeonmobs.gallery.rollback_f: [%s] %s placement and rollback both failed at %s. Stop retrying and restore an administrator-verified backup.
message.ftdungeonmobs.spawns.status: Dungeon encounters: tier %s, %s rooms prepared, %s points, %s completed, %s monsters remaining.
message.ftdungeonmobs.adventure.enter: Dungeon Adventure Mode: interactions and combat allowed; block edits forbidden. Your previous mode is restored on exit.
